na-goldberg.title: David Goldberg, What Every Computer Scientist Should Know About Floating-Point Arithmetic (1991)
na-goldberg.notes: Floating-point encoding, rounding, ulps and error behavior.

na-higham.title: Nicholas J. Higham, Accuracy and Stability of Numerical Algorithms, 2nd edition
na-higham.notes: Forward/backward error, conditioning, numerical stability, summation.

na-wilkinson.title: James H. Wilkinson, Rounding Errors in Algebraic Processes
na-wilkinson.notes: Development of backward-error viewpoint in numerical linear algebra.

na-kahan.title: William Kahan, Analysis and Application of Simply Compensated Summation (1993)
na-kahan.notes: Compensated summation and accumulation of rounding error.

na-demmel.title: James W. Demmel, Applied Numerical Linear Algebra (SIAM, 1997)
na-demmel.notes: Sensitivity, backward-error measures, residual bounds, pivoting, least squares and linear algebra.

na-trefethen-bau.title: Lloyd N. Trefethen and David Bau III, Numerical Linear Algebra (SIAM, 1997)
na-trefethen-bau.notes: Conditioning, Householder QR, pivoting, stability and iterative methods; Library of Congress table of contents.

na-mit18330.title: MIT OpenCourseWare 18.330, Introduction to Numerical Analysis (Spring 2004; Spring 2012)
na-mit18330.notes: Root finding, quadrature, numerical linear algebra, error and convergence, with educational handouts.

na-burden-faires.title: Richard L. Burden, J. Douglas Faires, and Annette M. Burden, Numerical Analysis (10th ed., Cengage, 2016)
na-burden-faires.notes: Root methods, numerical integration, approximation and elementary convergence and error analysis.

na-berrut-trefethen.title: Jean-Paul Berrut and Lloyd N. Trefethen, Barycentric Lagrange Interpolation (SIAM Review 46(3), 2004)
na-berrut-trefethen.notes: Lagrange interpolation, barycentric evaluation and numerical stability.

na-trefethen-atap.title: Lloyd N. Trefethen, Approximation Theory and Approximation Practice
na-trefethen-atap.notes: Chebyshev interpolation, approximation error, numerical algorithms and the Runge phenomenon.

na-mit-ode.title: MIT 18.330 numerical analysis notes, initial value problems and ODE solver stability
na-mit-ode.notes: Consistency and convergence orders, explicit and implicit Euler and Runge–Kutta stability.

na-scipy-tutorial.title: SciPy Manual, Integration tutorial
na-scipy-tutorial.notes: Adaptive quadrature examples, numerical error and missed-peak limitations.

na-scipy-quad.title: SciPy Manual, scipy.integrate.quad reference
na-scipy-quad.notes: QUADPACK adaptive integration, absolute and relative error estimates.

na-rump.title: Siegfried M. Rump, Verification Methods: Rigorous Results Using Floating-Point Arithmetic (Acta Numerica 19, 2010)
na-rump.notes: Directed rounding, interval Newton, verified computations and enclosures.

na-ieee-1788.title: IEEE 1788-2015 Standard for Interval Arithmetic (listed as inactive-reserved by IEEE)
na-ieee-1788.notes: 2015 definition of interval arithmetic models; inactive-reserved listing is not an assertion of current adoption.

na-cornell-krylov.title: David Bindel, Cornell CS6210 (Fall 2025): Lanczos and Arnoldi
na-cornell-krylov.notes: Krylov bases, Arnoldi and Lanczos recurrences.

na-cornell-eigen.title: David Bindel, Cornell CS6210 (Fall 2025): Large-Scale Eigensolvers
na-cornell-eigen.notes: Rayleigh-Ritz projection, Ritz values and residuals.

na-eth-sparse.title: ETH Zurich, Lecture Notes on Solving Large Scale Eigenvalue Problems
na-eth-sparse.notes: Lanczos/Arnoldi algorithms, large sparse matrices, numerical stability.

na-scipy-stiff.title: SciPy, solve_ivp numerical ODE solver documentation
na-scipy-stiff.notes: Implicit Radau and BDF, Jacobian requirements, tolerances.

na-hairerwanner.title: Ernst Hairer and Gerhard Wanner, Solving Ordinary Differential Equations II
na-hairerwanner.notes: A-stability, L-stability and stiff differential equation algorithms.

na-mit-ad.title: MIT OpenCourseWare 18.S096, Forward and Reverse-Mode Automatic Differentiation (2023)
na-mit-ad.notes: JVP/VJP algorithms, reverse-mode memory and derivative products.

na-griewank-walther.title: Andreas Griewank and Andrea Walther, Evaluating Derivatives (2nd ed.)
na-griewank-walther.notes: Foundations of forward and reverse automatic differentiation.

na-scipy-sparse.title: SciPy, Sparse Linear Algebra Documentation
na-scipy-sparse.notes: Adjoint linear solves and sparse numerical solvers.

na-capd-rigorous.title: CAPD DynSys, Poincare maps—interval-based methods
na-capd-rigorous.notes: Validated flow enclosures and rigorous return-map evaluation.

na-capd-sets.title: CAPD DynSys, DynSets
na-capd-sets.notes: Rigorously transported sets and affine coordinate transformations.

na-capd-taylor.title: CAPD DynSys, One-step Taylor method
na-capd-taylor.notes: Taylor methods and distinction between ordinary and rigorous variants.
